hypotheses.researchQuestion: Does actual data-center energization raise regional electricity sales/load?
hypotheses.transmissionMechanism: Energized compute and cooling add load; planned capacity alone does not.
hypotheses.dependentVariable: Weather-adjusted commercial/industrial electricity sales and peak load
confoundingFactors: Natural gas and other fuel costs

contradictoryEvidence.statement: Efficiency, onsite generation and delayed commissioning can weaken net grid demand; not a measured negative AI effect.
Official near-term forecast was reduced after demand assumption updates and request vetting; not evidence of realized falling AI demand.

hypotheses.evidenceGradeJustification: Complete AI-to-outcome mechanism not empirically tested. E1 source observations and E2 corporate arithmetic cannot promote this hypothesis.
hypotheses.proposedValidationMethod: Regional descriptive event panel first; causal event study only after exposure and counterfactual gates.
hypotheses.falsificationCriteria: No robust post-energization excess relative to comparable regions with adequate precision, or exposure timing is not verified.
hypotheses.knownLimitations: All data-center use differs from AI use; utility/state boundaries can dilute effect.
hypotheses.nextResearchAction: Qualify site-date-load and utility crosswalk before C1 estimation.

hypotheses.researchQuestion: Do pre-existing grid constraints amplify regional price pressure?
hypotheses.transmissionMechanism: Peak scarcity/congestion and regulated cost recovery mediate prices.
hypotheses.dependentVariable: Wholesale LMP and separately average retail rates
confoundingFactors: Natural gas and other fuel costs

contradictoryEvidence.statement: Supply expansion, fixed tariffs or long-term contracts can buffer prices.

hypotheses.evidenceGradeJustification: Complete AI-to-outcome mechanism not empirically tested. E1 source observations and E2 corporate arithmetic cannot promote this hypothesis.
hypotheses.proposedValidationMethod: Pre-specified constraint interaction; never treat retail composition changes as tariff effects.
hypotheses.falsificationCriteria: Constrained regions do not have systematically larger changes after controls; effect disappears with fuel/weather controls.
hypotheses.knownLimitations: Constraint and investment location are endogenous; wholesale/retail timing differs.
hypotheses.nextResearchAction: Authenticate constraint history and price feeds.

hypotheses.transmissionMechanism: Concentrated orders compete for transformers, labor and fixed-site construction.
hypotheses.dependentVariable: Electrical equipment PPI, construction compensation, lead times
confoundingFactors: Natural gas and other fuel costs

contradictoryEvidence.statement: Import substitution and manufacturer expansion can offset pressure; no replicated counterestimate.

hypotheses.evidenceGradeJustification: Complete AI-to-outcome mechanism not empirically tested. E1 source observations and E2 corporate arithmetic cannot promote this hypothesis.
hypotheses.proposedValidationMethod: Separate input families; distributed-lag descriptive association with broad construction controls.
hypotheses.falsificationCriteria: No differential input inflation relative to placebo equipment; nominal spending only follows prices.
hypotheses.knownLimitations: Construction excludes GPUs/racks and land; expenditure is price × quantity.
hypotheses.nextResearchAction: Qualify series IDs and nominal deflators.

hypotheses.transmissionMechanism: New generation/transmission and efficiency relax constraints, with rebound risk.
hypotheses.dependentVariable: Load per output unit, congestion and rate changes
confoundingFactors: Natural gas and other fuel costs

contradictoryEvidence.statement: Delayed interconnection and induced demand may keep pressure elevated.

hypotheses.evidenceGradeJustification: Complete AI-to-outcome mechanism not empirically tested. E1 source observations and E2 corporate arithmetic cannot promote this hypothesis.
hypotheses.proposedValidationMethod: Compare completed vs planned supply; lagged descriptive designs; no assumed utilization.
hypotheses.falsificationCriteria: No decline in constraint measures after actual additions or aggregate demand offsets intensity reductions.
hypotheses.knownLimitations: Compute output and efficiency denominator not harmonized.
hypotheses.nextResearchAction: Seek primary efficiency/utilization and in-service evidence.

hypotheses.researchQuestion: Does infrastructure spending increase selected firms’ financing requirements?
hypotheses.transmissionMechanism: Cash investment competes with other uses; debt/equity/prepayments/leases can fund the combined cash budget.
hypotheses.dependentVariable: Native-period net financing flows and liquidity changes
confoundingFactors: Maturity refinancing rather than new investment

contradictoryEvidence.statement: Substantial OCF and liquidity coexist with borrowing; issuance does not prove funding distress or AI necessity.

hypotheses.evidenceGradeJustification: Complete AI-to-outcome mechanism not empirically tested. E1 source observations and E2 corporate arithmetic cannot promote this hypothesis.
hypotheses.proposedValidationMethod: Preserve B2 bridges, extend firm coverage and timing without tracing fungible dollars to AI.
hypotheses.falsificationCriteria: Financing moves explained by refinancing/acquisitions/distributions or cash investment covered internally.
hypotheses.knownLimitations: Only Oracle/Amazon detailed; no AI allocation or complete obligation denominator.
hypotheses.nextResearchAction: Resolve B2 gates and add remaining firms in a later phase.

hypotheses.researchQuestion: Does financing demand affect sector borrowing conditions?
hypotheses.transmissionMechanism: Incremental issuance competes for credit under conditional supply/risk appetite.
hypotheses.dependentVariable: Issuer spreads and net issuance, not Treasury yields
confoundingFactors: Maturity refinancing rather than new investment

contradictoryEvidence.statement: Strong cash flow and diversification can sustain spreads despite issuance.

hypotheses.evidenceGradeJustification: Complete AI-to-outcome mechanism not empirically tested. E1 source observations and E2 corporate arithmetic cannot promote this hypothesis.
hypotheses.proposedValidationMethod: Issuer-level matched issuance windows with maturity/rating controls; market aggregate as descriptive context.
hypotheses.falsificationCriteria: No sector-relative spread/issuance change, or effect vanishes outside general risk shocks.
hypotheses.knownLimitations: Licensed long history and issuer spreads not qualified; spread changes could drive investment.
hypotheses.nextResearchAction: Qualify legally usable issuer-level credit data before analysis.

hypotheses.researchQuestion: Can AI investment demand contribute to real-rate pressure?
hypotheses.transmissionMechanism: Desired investment relative to saving may affect rates; measured TIPS also reflects policy and market premia.
hypotheses.dependentVariable: Real market yields; equilibrium rate remains unobserved
confoundingFactors: Maturity refinancing rather than new investment

contradictoryEvidence.statement: Saving, capital inflows and policy adjustment can offset investment demand.

hypotheses.evidenceGradeJustification: Complete AI-to-outcome mechanism not empirically tested. E1 source observations and E2 corporate arithmetic cannot promote this hypothesis.
hypotheses.proposedValidationMethod: Historical time-series decomposition as descriptive only; no credible AI Treasury instrument yet.
hypotheses.falsificationCriteria: Yield movement fully explained by policy/fiscal/global shocks; no incremental explanatory content out of sample.
hypotheses.knownLimitations: Small post-AI sample, endogenous policy and unobservable neutral rate.
hypotheses.nextResearchAction: Do not select causal aggregate-rate pilot.

hypotheses.researchQuestion: Do cash generation and alternative financing mitigate pressure?
hypotheses.transmissionMechanism: Internal funds/customer cash/equity and global investor demand can substitute for new borrowing.
hypotheses.dependentVariable: Net borrowing / liquidity conditional on investment
confoundingFactors: Maturity refinancing rather than new investment

contradictoryEvidence.statement: Alternative funding creates future performance or lease obligations; not free resources.

hypotheses.evidenceGradeJustification: Complete AI-to-outcome mechanism not empirically tested. E1 source observations and E2 corporate arithmetic cannot promote this hypothesis.
hypotheses.proposedValidationMethod: Cash-flow and contract bridge; never add prepaid receipts to OCF a second time.
hypotheses.falsificationCriteria: No mitigation after obligations and other cash uses are included; substitute funding increases required service.
hypotheses.knownLimitations: Customer refund/roll-forward and lease principal unresolved.
hypotheses.nextResearchAction: Keep B2 missing cells and no distress inference.

hypotheses.researchQuestion: Does operational AI use improve firm/sector productivity?
hypotheses.transmissionMechanism: Task assistance/reorganization may increase quality-adjusted output per hour.

contradictoryEvidence.statement: Implementation, skill mismatch and measurement may delay or offset gains.

hypotheses.evidenceGradeJustification: Complete AI-to-outcome mechanism not empirically tested. E1 source observations and E2 corporate arithmetic cannot promote this hypothesis.
hypotheses.proposedValidationMethod: Comparable survey vintages and industry panel; randomized/rollout designs separately audited, not extrapolated.
hypotheses.falsificationCriteria: No improvement after quality/selection controls; negative controls show same pattern.
hypotheses.knownLimitations: Survey adoption is not verified deployment; short post-break sample; task study external validity limited.
hypotheses.nextResearchAction: Acquire full study and replication protocol; maintain BTOS regimes separately.

hypotheses.researchQuestion: Does AI productivity lower unit labor cost vs counterfactual?
hypotheses.transmissionMechanism: Higher real output per paid hour can lower compensation per output, conditional on wages.

contradictoryEvidence.statement: Compensation, implementation spending or demand may absorb measured gains.

hypotheses.evidenceGradeJustification: Complete AI-to-outcome mechanism not empirically tested. E1 source observations and E2 corporate arithmetic cannot promote this hypothesis.
hypotheses.proposedValidationMethod: Decompose ULC identity and adoption associations; do not infer AI residual from TFP.
hypotheses.falsificationCriteria: ULC does not fall relative to controls once compensation/quality/capital are considered.
hypotheses.knownLimitations: Accounting identity does not identify AI causal productivity.
hypotheses.nextResearchAction: Qualify industry concordance, output and compensation revisions.

hypotheses.researchQuestion: Are production-cost gains passed through to customers?
hypotheses.transmissionMechanism: Competition and pricing rules determine price/margin response to cost savings.
hypotheses.dependentVariable: Matched producer/consumer item price changes and markups

contradictoryEvidence.statement: Higher markups, wages, demand or quality improvements can limit nominal price reductions.

hypotheses.evidenceGradeJustification: Complete AI-to-outcome mechanism not empirically tested. E1 source observations and E2 corporate arithmetic cannot promote this hypothesis.
hypotheses.proposedValidationMethod: Matched industry-product prices and cost shocks; assess measured pass-through independently of productivity.
hypotheses.falsificationCriteria: Costs fall but prices do not after quality/demand controls; margin gains dominate.
hypotheses.knownLimitations: Industry ULC and consumer baskets poorly aligned; services quality measurement.
hypotheses.nextResearchAction: Do not infer lower aggregate inflation from task productivity.

hypotheses.transmissionMechanism: Complementary investment and induced demand may slow measured supply effects or preserve margins.
hypotheses.dependentVariable: Productivity lag, price pass-through and utilization

contradictoryEvidence.statement: Some deployed tasks improve promptly; no universal implementation delay is established.

hypotheses.evidenceGradeJustification: Complete AI-to-outcome mechanism not empirically tested. E1 source observations and E2 corporate arithmetic cannot promote this hypothesis.
hypotheses.proposedValidationMethod: Lag structure with pre-specified adoption regime; heterogeneity and no universal J-curve assumption.
hypotheses.falsificationCriteria: Gains immediate and broad with competitive price pass-through and no net rebound.
hypotheses.knownLimitations: Intangible investment and concentration measures not qualified.
hypotheses.nextResearchAction: Register intangible and competition sources later; no annual GDP contribution assumed.

hypotheses.researchQuestion: Do bottlenecks generate temporary relative-price increases?
hypotheses.transmissionMechanism: Localized scarce inputs may rise relative to other prices; a price-level step need not persist as inflation.
hypotheses.dependentVariable: Sector price level and sector inflation separately
confoundingFactors: Natural gas and other fuel costs

contradictoryEvidence.statement: Supply completion or input substitution can reverse relative price pressure.

hypotheses.evidenceGradeJustification: Complete AI-to-outcome mechanism not empirically tested. E1 source observations and E2 corporate arithmetic cannot promote this hypothesis.
hypotheses.proposedValidationMethod: Separate relative price and inflation-rate changes; do not equate EIA retail prices with CPI.
hypotheses.falsificationCriteria: No sector differential after controls or temporary shock decays without persistent aggregate inflation.
hypotheses.knownLimitations: National weights and AI share unresolved.
hypotheses.nextResearchAction: Keep local estimates local; validate basket/channel before macro link.

hypotheses.researchQuestion: Does broad investment demand raise inflation under slack constraints?
hypotheses.transmissionMechanism: Demand for labor/materials may exceed short-run productive capacity.
hypotheses.dependentVariable: Core CPI/PCE inflation conditional on slack

contradictoryEvidence.statement: Crowding out other investment, imports and supply gains may limit net demand.

hypotheses.evidenceGradeJustification: Complete AI-to-outcome mechanism not empirically tested. E1 source observations and E2 corporate arithmetic cannot promote this hypothesis.
hypotheses.proposedValidationMethod: Descriptive accounting/channel analysis; causal aggregate estimate not feasible with current exposure.
hypotheses.falsificationCriteria: Investment displaces other demand or rises with supply without inflation differential.
hypotheses.knownLimitations: Company spending not national real AI investment; capacity slack modeled.
hypotheses.nextResearchAction: Qualify investment deflators and counterfactual; no numerical forecast.

hypotheses.researchQuestion: Could AI supply gains reduce inflation relative to no-AI?
hypotheses.transmissionMechanism: Productivity lowers marginal costs/potentially expands supply if passed through.
hypotheses.dependentVariable: Inflation relative to independently defined counterfactual

contradictoryEvidence.statement: Income/wealth demand, markup retention and rebound can offset supply gains.

hypotheses.evidenceGradeJustification: Complete AI-to-outcome mechanism not empirically tested. E1 source observations and E2 corporate arithmetic cannot promote this hypothesis.
hypotheses.proposedValidationMethod: Identify adoption→productivity→cost→price separately; no mechanical addition of overlapping effects.
hypotheses.falsificationCriteria: No attributable productivity or price pass-through; demand offsets supply in matched evidence.
hypotheses.knownLimitations: No accepted no-AI aggregate counterfactual or project revenue allocation.
hypotheses.nextResearchAction: Require staged channel evidence, not an aggregate AI residual.

hypotheses.researchQuestion: How does policy offset/amplify investment-price pressures?
hypotheses.transmissionMechanism: Reaction functions influence demand, financing and expectations simultaneously.
hypotheses.dependentVariable: Inflation and expectations conditional on policy response

contradictoryEvidence.statement: Credible stabilization can contain persistence even when relative prices change.

hypotheses.proposedValidationMethod: Only externally identified policy shocks in later research; endogenous rate controls insufficient.
hypotheses.falsificationCriteria: Observed persistence absent, or apparent effect driven by general policy/inflation news.
hypotheses.knownLimitations: No AI-specific exogenous policy shock or sufficient sample.
hypotheses.nextResearchAction: Do not infer policy causality from simultaneous rate/inflation movements.

hypotheses.researchQuestion: Could local effects be undetectable in aggregate inflation?
hypotheses.transmissionMechanism: Small basket shares, offsets and spatial concentration dilute sector effects.

contradictoryEvidence.statement: Broad persistent input spillovers could make national effects material, but none are estimated here.

hypotheses.proposedValidationMethod: Power/detectability assessment and compatible expenditure weights before any macro causal claim.
hypotheses.falsificationCriteria: Stable, robust national effect with valid attribution rejects localization; imprecision alone is not evidence of zero.
